id.title: Generator .htaccess dan php.ini · Tools SagalaIT
id.lead: Pilih aturan yang Anda butuhkan, lalu salin atau unduh hasilnya: paksa HTTPS, seragamkan www, front controller, cache, gzip, blokir file berbahaya, dan header keamanan, plus php.ini untuk produksi atau pengembangan. Tidak ada yang dikirim ke server.
id.o_front_h: Permintaan ke file atau folder yang tidak ada diteruskan ke satu file PHP
id.copy_fail: Tidak bisa menyalin di browser ini
id.how_ht: Letakkan sebagai .htaccess di folder situs (public_html atau public). Pastikan AllowOverride mengizinkan, lalu coba di staging dulu dan simpan cadangan .htaccess lama.
id.how_php: Salin ke php.ini atau ke file .ini di folder conf.d, lalu restart PHP-FPM atau Apache. Periksa dengan phpinfo() atau php --ini.
id.he_entry: File masuk harus berakhiran .php dan hanya berisi huruf, angka, titik, minus, dan garis bawah. Dipakai nilai bawaan index.php.
id.he_base: RewriteBase harus diawali / dan hanya berisi huruf, angka, titik, minus, garis bawah, tilde, dan garis miring. Dikosongkan.
id.hw_https: Pastikan sertifikat HTTPS sudah aktif sebelum menyalakan paksa HTTPS, kalau tidak pengunjung melihat peringatan keamanan.
id.hw_loop: Di balik proxy atau CDN tanpa opsi "Di belakang proxy", pengalihan HTTPS bisa berulang tanpa henti.
id.hw_www_add: Aturan tambah www tidak cocok untuk localhost, alamat IP, dan subdomain: blog.contoh.com akan menjadi www.blog.contoh.com.
id.hw_hsts: HSTS tidak bisa dibatalkan dari server selama browser masih menyimpannya. Mulai dengan 1 minggu.
id.hw_hsts_sub: Sertakan subdomain memaksa HTTPS di semua subdomain. Pastikan semuanya sudah siap.
id.hw_hsts_no_https: HSTS hanya berarti bila situs sudah memakai HTTPS.
id.hw_cache: Bila file aset diganti dengan nama yang sama, pengunjung bisa melihat versi lama sampai cache habis. Pakai nama berversi.
id.hw_indexes: Options -Indexes memerlukan AllowOverride Options. Bila host melarang, hasilnya error 500: hapus baris itu.
id.hw_sens: Daftar file sensitif ikut memblokir .ini, .config, dan composer.json. Pastikan situs Anda tidak memuatnya langsung lewat URL.
id.hw_csp: CSP mode lapor saja belum melindungi apa pun. Sesuaikan sumbernya dengan situs Anda, lalu ubah menjadi Content-Security-Policy.
id.hw_modules: Tiap blok dibungkus IfModule: bila modulnya tidak aktif di server, aturannya diam-diam tidak berjalan. Aktifkan rewrite, headers, deflate, dan alias bila perlu.
id.hw_nothing: Belum ada aturan yang dipilih, hasilnya hanya berisi komentar.
id.pe_size: Ukuran harus berupa angka dengan K, M, atau G, misalnya 64M. Dipakai nilai bawaan.
id.pe_time: Waktu maksimum harus bilangan bulat 0 sampai 3600. Dipakai 60.
id.pe_log: Jalur log harus berupa jalur absolut tanpa spasi atau tanda kutip. Dikosongkan.
id.pw_post: post_max_size lebih kecil dari upload_max_filesize, jadi unggahan besar akan gagal. Buat post_max_size sedikit lebih besar.
id.pw_secure: session.cookie_secure = 1 mengharuskan HTTPS. Di HTTP biasa, sesi tidak akan tersimpan.
id.pw_opcache: validate_timestamps = 0: PHP tidak membaca ulang file yang berubah. Setelah deploy, reset OPcache atau restart PHP-FPM.
id.pw_disable: Mematikan fungsi eksekusi perintah bisa merusak aplikasi yang memanggil program luar (Composer, backup, pemrosesan gambar). Hapus dari daftar bila ada yang gagal.
id.hc_head:
Dibuat dengan Tools SagalaIT, untuk Apache 2.4.
Simpan cadangan .htaccess lama dan coba di staging dulu: satu baris yang salah bisa membuat situs error 500.
id.hc_dot: Blokir file dan folder berawalan titik (.git, .env, ...). Folder .well-known tetap boleh untuk sertifikat dan keamanan.
id.hc_sens: Blokir file sensitif yang sering tertinggal di server: cadangan, SQL, log, konfigurasi, composer.json.
id.hc_hsts: HSTS: browser menolak HTTP ke situs ini selama waktu yang ditentukan. Sulit dibatalkan, mulai dengan nilai kecil.
id.hc_csp: CSP awal, mode lapor saja: tidak memblokir apa pun. Sesuaikan lalu ubah menjadi Content-Security-Policy.
id.hc_gzip: Kompres teks sebelum dikirim. Gambar dan font woff2 sudah terkompres, jadi tidak ikut.
id.hc_cache: Cache aset statis {days} hari. HTML tidak diberi cache. Pakai nama berversi (app.v2.css) agar perubahan terlihat.
id.hc_proxy: Di belakang proxy atau CDN: HTTPS dikenali dari X-Forwarded-Proto.
id.hc_proto: Catat skema permintaan supaya pengalihan www tidak mengubah http ke https atau sebaliknya.
id.hc_auth: Teruskan header Authorization ke PHP (perlu pada PHP-FPM atau CGI).
id.hc_front: Front controller: permintaan ke file atau folder yang tidak ada diteruskan ke {entry}.
id.pc_head:
Dibuat dengan Tools SagalaIT, profil {profile}.
Salin ke php.ini (atau file .ini di conf.d), lalu restart PHP-FPM atau Apache.
id.pc_err_prod: Kesalahan dicatat ke log dan tidak ditampilkan ke pengunjung.
id.pc_err_dev: Semua kesalahan tampil di layar. Jangan dipakai di produksi.
id.pc_disable: Fungsi eksekusi perintah dimatikan. Hapus dari daftar bila ada aplikasi yang membutuhkannya.
id.pc_limits: Batas sumber daya dan unggahan. post_max_size harus lebih besar dari upload_max_filesize.
id.pc_assert: Assertion: mati di produksi, hidup saat pengembangan.
id.pc_opcache_prod: OPcache untuk produksi: file tidak dicek ulang. Setelah deploy, panggil opcache_reset() atau restart PHP-FPM.
id.pc_opcache_dev: OPcache untuk pengembangan: file dicek ulang di setiap permintaan.

en.title: .htaccess and php.ini generator · Tools SagalaIT
en.lead: Pick the rules you need, then copy or download the result: force HTTPS, normalize www, front controller, caching, gzip, blocking dangerous files, and security headers, plus a php.ini for production or development. Nothing is sent to a server.
en.o_proxy_h: Detect HTTPS from the X-Forwarded-Proto header
en.o_front_h: Requests for files or folders that do not exist go to a single PHP file
en.how_ht: Place it as .htaccess in the site folder (public_html or public). Make sure AllowOverride permits it, try it on staging first, and keep a backup of the old .htaccess.
en.how_php: Copy it into php.ini or into a .ini file in the conf.d folder, then restart PHP-FPM or Apache. Verify with phpinfo() or php --ini.
en.he_entry: The entry file must end in .php and contain only letters, digits, dots, hyphens, and underscores. The default index.php is used.
en.he_base: RewriteBase must start with / and contain only letters, digits, dots, hyphens, underscores, tildes, and slashes. It was left empty.
en.hw_https: Make sure the HTTPS certificate is active before turning on forced HTTPS, otherwise visitors see a security warning.
en.hw_loop: Behind a proxy or CDN without the "Behind a proxy" option, the HTTPS redirect can loop forever.
en.hw_www_add: The add-www rule does not suit localhost, IP addresses, or subdomains: blog.example.com would become www.blog.example.com.
en.hw_hsts: HSTS cannot be undone from the server while browsers still remember it. Start with 1 week.
en.hw_hsts_sub: Include subdomains forces HTTPS on every subdomain. Make sure all of them are ready.
en.hw_hsts_no_https: HSTS only makes sense once the site already uses HTTPS.
en.hw_cache: If an asset file is replaced under the same name, visitors can keep seeing the old version until the cache expires. Use versioned names.
en.hw_indexes: Options -Indexes needs AllowOverride Options. If the host forbids it, the result is a 500 error: delete that line.
en.hw_sens: The sensitive file list also blocks .ini, .config, and composer.json. Make sure your site does not load them directly by URL.
en.hw_csp: A report-only CSP protects nothing yet. Adapt its sources to your site, then change it to Content-Security-Policy.
en.hw_modules: Every block is wrapped in IfModule: if a module is not enabled on the server, its rules silently do nothing. Enable rewrite, headers, deflate, and alias if needed.
en.hw_nothing: No rules are selected, so the result contains only comments.
en.pe_size: A size must be a number followed by K, M, or G, for example 64M. The default is used.
en.pe_time: The maximum time must be a whole number from 0 to 3600. 60 is used.
en.pe_log: The log path must be an absolute path with no spaces or quotes. It was left empty.
en.pw_post: post_max_size is smaller than upload_max_filesize, so large uploads will fail. Make post_max_size slightly larger.
en.pw_secure: session.cookie_secure = 1 requires HTTPS. On plain HTTP, sessions will not stick.
en.pw_opcache: validate_timestamps = 0: PHP does not re-read changed files. After a deploy, reset OPcache or restart PHP-FPM.
en.pw_disable: Disabling command execution functions can break apps that call outside programs (Composer, backups, image processing). Remove them from the list if something fails.
en.hc_head:
Made with Tools SagalaIT, for Apache 2.4.
Keep a backup of your old .htaccess and try this on staging first: a single wrong line can cause a 500 error.
en.hc_dot: Block files and folders that start with a dot (.git, .env, ...). The .well-known folder stays allowed for certificates and security.
en.hc_sens: Block sensitive files that often get left on servers: backups, SQL, logs, configuration, composer.json.
en.hc_hsts: HSTS: browsers refuse HTTP to this site for the given time. Hard to undo, start small.
en.hc_csp: Starter CSP, report only: it blocks nothing. Adapt it, then change it to Content-Security-Policy.
en.hc_gzip: Compress text before sending. Images and woff2 fonts are already compressed, so they are left out.
en.hc_cache: Cache static assets for {days} days. HTML is not cached. Use versioned names (app.v2.css) so changes show up.
en.hc_proxy: Behind a proxy or CDN: HTTPS is detected from X-Forwarded-Proto.
en.hc_proto: Remember the request scheme so the www redirect does not turn http into https or the other way around.
en.hc_auth: Pass the Authorization header to PHP (needed on PHP-FPM or CGI).
en.hc_front: Front controller: requests for files or folders that do not exist go to {entry}.
en.pc_head:
Made with Tools SagalaIT, {profile} profile.
Copy it into php.ini (or a .ini file in conf.d), then restart PHP-FPM or Apache.
en.pc_err_prod: Errors are logged and not shown to visitors.
en.pc_err_dev: All errors show on screen. Do not use this in production.
en.pc_disable: Command execution functions are disabled. Remove them from the list if an app needs them.
en.pc_limits: Resource and upload limits. post_max_size must be larger than upload_max_filesize.
en.pc_assert: Assertions: off in production, on during development.
en.pc_opcache_prod: OPcache for production: files are not re-checked. After a deploy, call opcache_reset() or restart PHP-FPM.
en.pc_opcache_dev: OPcache for development: files are re-checked on every request.
